title: JDY-31A V2.241 (SPP + BLE)
notes: JDY-31A V2.241: 5 UART reads verified; NAME write/readback PASS; BAUD/PIN writes reported OK by operator. FACTORY restore AT+DEFAULT is DOCUMENTED for legacy JDY-31 but UNTESTED on this firmware. Before sending, Studio snapshots current values and checks firmware. After reset, reconnect at 9600 and read core. BLE GATT is separate.

edit.hint: Physically verified on JDY-31A V2.241: AT+NAME{value} returned +OK and matched UART readback (15 Oct 2026). Persistence across power-cycle not yet tested. Re-pairing may be required.
Changes UART baud index (4..9) for the next session. Confirm before sending: after power-cycle, change the PC COM baud to the selected rate; immediate readback may be unavailable.
Changes the SPP pairing PIN, exactly four decimal digits. Re-pair bonded devices if needed. Values must not be published.

factory_reset.notes: Factory reset documented for JDY-31 V1.x, not yet verified on JDY-31A V2.241. Restored defaults must be measured; original pre-test name JDY-31, baud 4 and PIN 1234 are observed baseline, NOT proof of factory state.
